title: Gita for Children
subtitle: From learning the Gita’s shlokas to living their wisdom
shortDescription: A learning journey that helps children move from learning the Gita’s shlokas to living their wisdom.
description: Children encounter selected shlokas through chanting, stories, dialogue, contemplation and practical experiments. The journey helps them recognise familiar struggles and respond with greater clarity, responsibility and care.

image.alt: Children learning, chanting and applying the wisdom of the Gita

recommendedProcess.title: Encounter
recommendedProcess.description: Meet the teaching through story, chanting and dialogue.

recommendedProcess.title: Inquire
recommendedProcess.description: Recognise the human struggle within the teaching.

recommendedProcess.title: Try
recommendedProcess.description: Apply one insight in family, school or friendship.

recommendedProcess.title: Reflect
recommendedProcess.description: Return to the group, share and deepen understanding.

intendedOutcomes: Recognise life’s struggles with greater honesty.
Understand selected shlokas and their relevance.
Respond to situations with greater clarity and care.

title: Gita Sāra
subtitle: The essence of the Gita through 126 chosen shlokas
shortDescription: A structured exploration of the Gita’s central teachings through 126 carefully chosen shlokas.
description: Guided teaching, reflection and application reveal how the Gita’s foundational ideas belong to one integrated vision of life. Learners build a coherent understanding without first undertaking all 700 shlokas.

image.alt: Selected shlokas illuminating the essence of the Gita

intendedOutcomes: Recognise relationships among its foundational ideas.
Use selected teachings in everyday inquiry and action.

title: Pūrṇa Yoga Darśana
subtitle: A deep-dive journey into the Gita through all 700 shlokas
shortDescription: Study the Bhagavad Gita as a complete and integrated vision of life and Yoga.
description: A long-term guided inquiry into every shloka and the relationships among action, knowledge, devotion, meditation and freedom. This Experience is intended for learners ready for sustained, careful study.

image.alt: An expansive path representing the complete vision of the Bhagavad Gita

recommendedProcess.title: Study
recommendedProcess.description: Enter each chapter and shloka with an Acharya.

recommendedProcess.title: Connect
recommendedProcess.description: See relationships across the complete teaching.

recommendedProcess.title: Contemplate
recommendedProcess.description: Examine the vision in lived experience.

intendedOutcomes: Understand the Bhagavad Gita as an integrated vision.
Recognise the unity of its approaches to Yoga.
Develop sustained habits of scriptural inquiry and contemplation.

title: Gita Yoga
subtitle: Learn to chant all 700 shlokas
shortDescription: A complete chanting journey through all eighteen chapters of the Bhagavad Gita.
description: Progress chapter by chapter with guided pronunciation, metre, rhythm and repetition. Regular practice develops accuracy, confidence, attentiveness and reverence for the complete text.

image.alt: Rhythmic chanting flowing through the eighteen chapters of the Gita

commitment.summary: Complete chanting journey covering all 18 chapters

intendedOutcomes: Chant all 700 shlokas with growing accuracy.
Develop rhythm, confidence and attentive listening.
Approach the text with steadiness and reverence.
